jobs.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,difflib,re,os,datetime
root=Path('/Users/robault/GitHub/sugata-avatar');p=root/'docs/evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/artist-checklist-reconciliation'
print('PID',os.getpid(),'UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat());m=json.loads((p/'INPUTS.json').read_text());pins=[]
for row in m['pins']+[m['saved_baseline']]:
 b=Path(row['path']).read_bytes();a={'path':row['path'],'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()};assert a==row;pins.append(a)
base=(p/'BASELINE.md.txt').read_text();cand=(p/'PROJECT-CHECKLIST.candidate.md').read_text();diff=(p/'CANDIDATE.diff').read_text();c=json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE.json').read_text())
assert base==(root/'docs/PROJECT-CHECKLIST.md').read_text()
assert ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(base.splitlines(True),cand.splitlines(True),fromfile='docs/PROJECT-CHECKLIST.md',tofile='PROJECT-CHECKLIST.candidate.md'))==diff
assert base.split('## Artist and research deliverables available')[0]==cand.split('## Artist and research deliverables available')[0]
assert base.split('## Outstanding',1)[1]==cand.split('## Outstanding',1)[1]
bl=base.splitlines();cl=cand.splitlines();oldm=next(x for x in bl if x.startswith('- [x] Original Mara artist discussion'));newm=next(x for x in cl if x.startswith('- [x] Original Mara artist discussion'));knit=next(x for x in cl if x.startswith('- [x] Supplementary knitwear'))
oldboard=next(x for x in bl if x.startswith('[Open the visual wardrobe board]'));newboard=next(x for x in cl if x.startswith('[Open the visual wardrobe board]'))
assert cand==base.replace('## Artist and research deliverables available\n\n','## Artist and research deliverables available\n\n'+knit+'\n\n').replace(oldm,newm).replace(oldboard,newboard)
oldrows=[x for x in bl if x.startswith('- [x]')];newrows=[x for x in cl if x.startswith('- [x]')];assert [x for x in oldrows if x!=oldm]==[x for x in newrows if x not in [newm,knit]]
links=re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',cand);resolved=[]
for link in links:
 q=(root/'docs'/link).resolve();assert q.is_file(),(link,q);resolved.append({'literal':link,'resolved':str(q)})
newlinks=[x for x in links if x not in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',base)];assert newlinks==c['new_links']
counts=lambda text:{'checked':len(re.findall(r'^- \[x\]',text,re.M)),'open':len(re.findall(r'^- \[ \]',text,re.M))}
assert counts(base)==c['baseline_counts']=={'checked':22,'open':10};assert counts(cand)==c['candidate_counts']=={'checked':23,'open':10}
spaces=lambda text:[i for i,x in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1) if x.rstrip(' \t')!=x]
assert spaces(base)==spaces(cand)==[];assert spaces(diff)==[4,6,13,15,18,20,22,24,27,29]
assert all(diff.splitlines()[i-1]==' ' for i in spaces(diff));assert diff.endswith(' \n')
print(json.dumps({'verified_manifest_rows':len(pins),'baseline_canonical_equal':True,'literal_diff_exact':True,'exact3changes':True,'usable_section_exact':True,'usable_checked_rows':7,'other_artist_rows_exact':True,'entire_outstanding_tail_exact':True,'counts_before':counts(base),'counts_after':counts(cand),'artist_rows_before':15,'artist_rows_after':16,'all_link_occurrences':len(links),'new_links':newlinks,'new_links_resolve_in_intended_canonical_docs_directory':True,'candidate_baseline_trailing_whitespace_rows':[],'literal_diff_single_space_context_rows':spaces(diff),'literal_diff_final_blank_context_line':29,'resolved_links':resolved},indent=2))
PY
